plants.name: Lavandula angustifolia
plants.description: Silvery-green mounds of fragrant foliage carry slender spikes of violet-blue flowers. In the south of France, the blooms roll across the hillsides in long, perfumed rows. Bees crowd the flowers, and the warm air smells sweet and herbal. By early August the main peak has passed, but many fields and gardens are still in flower.
plants.bloomingSeason: Mid-June to late August, with peak bloom in July
plants.location: Provence and the French Alps, France
plants.funFact: The name lavender probably comes from the Latin 'lavare', meaning 'to wash'. Romans scented their baths with it.

plants.name: Helianthus annuus
plants.description: These tall, sturdy plants carry golden flower heads as wide as dinner plates. The heads follow the sun across the sky when young, and whole fields glow against the summer sky. In the Great Plains, sunflowers grow wild along roadsides and are also planted as a major crop.
plants.bloomingSeason: July to October, with individual fields flowering for about two weeks
plants.location: Kansas and the Great Plains, United States
plants.funFact: A sunflower head is not one flower. It is a cluster of hundreds or even thousands of tiny florets, and each one can become a seed.
